mapper.select: SELECT tc.id, tc.case_no, tc.requirement_id, tc.module, tc.title, tc.test_purpose, tc.precondition, tc.steps, tc.expected_result, tc.priority, tc.case_type, tc.status, tc.actual_result, tc.attachment, tc.remark, tc.executor, tc.execute_time, tc.create_time, tc.update_time, GROUP_CONCAT(b.bug_no, ', ') AS related_bug_nos FROM test_case tc LEFT JOIN bug b ON tc.id = b.case_id WHERE tc.requirement_id = #{requirementId} GROUP BY tc.id ORDER BY tc.id ASC

SELECT tc.id, tc.case_no, tc.requirement_id, tc.module, tc.title, tc.test_purpose, tc.precondition, tc.steps, tc.expected_result, tc.priority, tc.case_type, tc.status, tc.actual_result, tc.attachment, tc.remark, tc.executor, tc.execute_time, tc.create_time, tc.update_time, GROUP_CONCAT(b.bug_no, ', ') AS related_bug_nos FROM test_case tc LEFT JOIN bug b ON tc.id = b.case_id WHERE tc.id = #{id} GROUP BY tc.id
